SAMPLE Growth Grant

The SAMPLE Growth Grant is a non-repayable contribution that helps small businesses in Newfoundland and Labrador buy equipment or adopt new software.

Who can apply

  • Businesses operating in Newfoundland and Labrador
  • Sole proprietors, partnerships or corporations
  • Businesses with fewer than 100 employees
  • Projects to buy equipment or adopt software or digital tools
  • Projects costing at least $10,000
  • Applicants must have a business plan that shows the project is viable

Funding

Up to $50,000 per project, covering up to 50 per cent of eligible costs.

How to apply

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis, with no deadline. It’s best to talk to us before you apply.
